name: geneos_mcp
schema: openferment_core (packages/core) — canonical Pydantic models; nothing is hand-written here

tools.name: health
tools.note: corpusSnapshotId is a sha256 digest of the corpus bytes read at startup, never a constant.

tools.name: list_strains
tools.returns: envelope { data: Strain[] } — bsl included, because Protocol.bsl bounds which protocols a host can be run under

tools.name: get_strain
tools.returns: envelope { data: Strain | null, ..., notice? } — null carries a notice naming the miss

tools.name: get_strain_records
tools.note: The attribution rule — tagged with the strain, or, absent a tag, belonging to a paper whose organism list names it — is openferment_core.corpus.records_attributed_to, not this server's. scripts/check-servers.mjs replays every strain through it and the TypeScript fixture and fails if they disagree.

tools.name: predict_flux
tools.behaviour: refuses: no genome-scale metabolic model in this build. Flux balance is COBRApy's, in Python, server-side. A prediction is absent rather than estimated — the same fact every design in this build reports as an absent T1.

deliberateAbsences: No tool designs, edits or registers a strain. A host record is what protocols, records and biosafety bounds are keyed to; adding one unattended would create a chassis nobody built and let a BSL be asserted rather than assessed.
